name: X-linked Complicated Corpus Callosum Dysgenesis
aliases: X-linked Corpus Callosum Agenesis with Complications

criteria.description: Neuroimaging evidence of partial or complete agenesis/dysgenesis of the corpus callosum
Family history consistent with X-linked inheritance pattern
Presence of neurological deficits including developmental delay and intellectual disability
Additional brain malformations or systemic anomalies detected by imaging or clinical exam

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of corpus callosum dysgenesis on imaging plus neurological impairment with evidence of X-linked inheritance
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for causative mutations may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

laboratory: Possible metabolic screening abnormalities in some cases
imaging: MRI showing agenesis or dysgenesis of corpus callosum
Additional brain malformations such as cortical dysplasia or ventriculomegaly
genetic: Mutations in genes linked to X-linked corpus callosum malformations (e.g., ARX gene mutations)
other: Family pedigree analysis consistent with X-linked inheritance

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated corpus callosum agenesis without systemic anomalies
History of perinatal injury or infection

redFlags: Severe developmental delay with seizures in male infants
Family history of similar neurological disorders in males
Presence of multiple congenital anomalies alongside corpus callosum dysgenesis
references: Orphanet Report on X-linked Complicated Corpus Callosum Dysgenesis, ORPHA:1497
Recent Review on Corpus Callosum Malformations in Pediatric Neurology Journals
